note: Explore.Blazor.Client is Blazor WebAssembly (.razor + MudBlazor v9), not JS/React. There is no compiled component bundle to sync. This project holds a hand-written design-tokens/style reference only (see .design-sync/conventions.md) so a design agent can approximate the look with generic components. Not a full package/storybook sync — no 'shape' or 'pkg' field is set.
